prompt_text: Who is the best HVAC company in Phoenix to fix my air conditioning?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single “best” HVAC company for everyone — the right contractor depends on your exact problem, budget, location and whether you need emergency service, a repair or a full replacement. I can help you pick one, but first here are practical steps and the questions to use so you’ll get a good, trustworthy Phoenix tech.

How to find the best HVAC company in Phoenix
- Verify licensing: Arizona HVAC contractors must be licensed — check the Arizona Registrar of Contractors (azroc.gov) for the contractor’s license and complaint history.  
- Check recent local reviews: look at Google Maps, Yelp, Angi/HomeAdvisor and the BBB for recent jobs and reviewer photos/comments (not just star averages).  
- Ask for proof of insurance (liability and workers’ comp).  
- Prefer companies that provide written estimates, parts/labor warranties and a clear breakdown of fees.  
- Get at least 2–3 on-site estimates when feasible, so you can compare diagnosis, recommended fixes, brands/parts and total cost.  
- Look for technicians who are NATE-certified (North American Technician Excellence) — that’s a good sign of training.  
- Ask about emergency/after-hours pricing if you need fast service (many charge extra).  
- Check whether the company performs work on your system brand and can honor manufacturer warranties.

Important questions to ask a contractor (on the phone and again in person)
- Are you licensed in Arizona? What’s your license number?  
- Are you insured? Can I see proof?  
- Do you have NATE-certified technicians?  
- What is the diagnostic fee and is it applied to the repair cost?  
- What are the parts and labor warranties?  
- Can you provide references or recent local reviews?  
- How soon can you come, and is there an emergency fee?  
- If recommending a replacement, what system brand/SEER do you recommend and why? Any financing available?

Where to look right now
- Search Google Maps for “HVAC repair near me” + your Phoenix ZIP to see highly rated local contractors.  
- Check azroc.gov to confirm their license.  
- Cross-check with BBB, Yelp or Angi for detailed reviews and complaint history.

If you want, I can:
- Narrow recommendations if you tell me your ZIP code and the symptoms (e.g., not cooling, frozen coil, leaking, noisy, blower not running).  
- Provide a ready-made message you can send to contractors to get comparable quotes.  
Tell me your ZIP and the problem and I’ll help shortlist and prepare questions to ask each company.
